pages.title: Metropolis Zone
pages.text: Metropolis Zone is the eighth level of Sonic the Hedgehog 2 (Sega, 1992). Its graphics were made by the artist Tom Payne, who had first drawn them for a level called Genocide City. That level was renamed Cyber City and then built into Metropolis, according to Wikipedia and Sega Retro.

pages.title: Scratching and guitar
pages.text: In the Sonic Stadium Soundtrack Squad Review (2010), the reviewer BlitzChris wrote of "the scratching and popping of the mechanical Metropolis". T-BIRD praised its "wonderful scratch and guitar-riffic chorus".
